formats.fp4: I8 packed two E2M1 nibbles per source byte; scale UE8M0 per output row per 32 K; 2 blocks +2 scale bytes =272 useful bits per 274-bit word
formats.fp8: F8_E4M3 codes; shared source UE8M0 scale per 32 rows x32 K; execution replication of scale per row costs physical bytes; one 32-code block +8-bit scale =264 useful bits
formats.bf16: 16 values per 274-bit word (256 payload); preserve source BF16 bits
formats.wo_a: Source FP8 with UE8M0; current engine storage expands to BF16_RNE. Either price this 2x expansion or add separately priced exact conversion to BF16 before compute; do not execute native FP8 dot as substitute
formats.tables_aux: Retain all source dtype/shape bytes; 256-bit raw payload per 274-bit physical word in existing codec; table row gather and provider output require separate service

golden.quantized_chunk_rule: 8 block-dot FP32 terms sequentially from +0; then padded binary tree
golden.bf16_chunk_rule: 8 scalar products sequentially from +0; then padded binary tree
golden.split_rule: Segments are contiguous power-of-two aligned runs of golden chunks. Finish original padded tree in node order. Never arbitrary even K slicing/reassociation. Pin ARITH mode and class from released execution contract.
golden.fp4_existing_layout: Pair sibling 256-K chunks in two word halves; odd final chunk retains explicit +0 sibling. Existing K=2304 row uses40 words vs compact36 (11.11% extra). Compact layout is feasible with lane-valid metadata but requires exactness and address implementation.

recommended_allocation: Partition by source layer and phase, then output rows across all local compute clusters in the stage. Keep each output row local initially: this maximizes compute reuse without remote partial-sum traffic.

For each cluster assign all experts a deterministic quota of rows. Thus every selected expert has resident work in every cluster; no probability of an expert landing entirely behind one compute island. Account residual ceil-row imbalance.

Inside a cluster allocate matrix row packets into fixed-depth real macros with explicit tuple(tensor,row,K span,code bits,scale bits,bank,row,bit); use least-filled eligible bank placement and immutable per-bank interval bounds. Charge physical depth rounding and holes.
Cluster bank groups share ports: use deterministic bank calendar over actual resident bank rows. Shared compute inputs come from selected-bank mux tree, not a hypothetical aggregation of all macros.

Introduce K splitting only for matrices with too few rows to fill chosen compute. Keep splits inside cluster when possible and price partial buffering plus exact tree. Compare golden subtree lengths rather than number of nominal splits.

Keep gate/up/activation/down within same cluster where expert partition permits; down outputs then require explicitly priced exact reduction or input gather. Cannot simultaneously claim row-local complete gate/up and independent down without paying intermediate communication.

Head complete rows striped across clusters; local logits feed local winner consumer, then exact global tie-aware winner reduction. Preserve exceptional-value semantics. Embedding/head source tensors remain distinct unless equality proven and separately authorized.

timing_bound.per_bank: D_b = actual selected physical words on bank b / physical accepted reads per cycle (capture-ready inclusive)
timing_bound.per_cluster: T >= max(max_b D_b, total selected words / mux_output_words_per_cycle, exact arithmetic issue cycles, operand ingress, output egress) + dependency latency; shared resource conflicts require calendar not naive max
timing_bound.per_system: critical-path stage sum plus priced links/CDC/reduction. Sum capacities is never read-bandwidth proof

expert_collision.distributed_rows: For E selected experts and identical row allocation, cluster c performs sum_e rows[e,c] work. Report max_c, not average. Rotated remainder rows minimize small imbalance.
expert_collision.expert_local_tiles: If experts assigned whole to T tiles, selected-set service depends on max_t load_t. Absolute worst=min(E,experts_per_tile) experts at one tile. E=6 may cause6 waves despite mean6/T. A probabilistic mean is not worst-case latency.
expert_collision.bank_collision: Even full cluster spread leaves per-bank conflicts. Six expert IDs feed address calendar; enumerate measured/checkpoint selections plus adversarial bank-coincident set. Do not substitute uniform random routing as guarantee.
